description: Rochford District Council is an Essex district (non-stock-holding; shared 'OneTeam' services with Brentwood BC). District feeds are procurement-dominant: no ASC/children's Care Act direct payments (county function), so no REDACTED bucket expected. Default: procurement_paid. REDACTED rule retained defensively — suffix-tolerant regex costs nothing if the bucket is empty.

match.supplier_regex: ^(\[REDACTED\]|REDACT(ED)?([ \-,].*)?|NAME WITHHELD|PAYMENT TO AN INDIVIDUAL|PAYMENT TO INDIVIDUAL)$

rules.reason: Defensive: districts occasionally publish redacted rows (housing benefit / DHP recipients). Anchored regex avoids false positives on real suppliers.

Corporate card statement settlements (2,680 rows / £250K, avg £93) — the underlying merchants are not itemised, so 'BARCLAY CARD' is a settlement artefact, not a supplier. Excluded from supplier leagues / HHI / duplicate analyses; totals still count it.
Default for Rochford. Single payments-over-£500 feed, no PO/invoice split. Rochford Norse Ltd (Norse JV) stays procurement_paid per the JV / minority-ownership rule.
